scope.description: Library-to-caller message publication dependency for positive remote MsgAppResp under the asynchronous storage interface, with a legal accepted append followed by a duplicate before local storage completion.
assumptions: Message duplication is exact and originates from an actual leader-produced MsgApp in the same execution.
The caller processes local append messages reliably and in order and releases attached responses only after completion.
No crash, membership change or malformed network message is needed.
excluded: Disk crash persistence, global agreement after restart and client-visible application results.
Liveness under indefinite local storage delay.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target changes. MemoryStorage is a deterministic substitute for application storage completion, not disk durability.
Instrumentation reads Ready messages and public MemoryStorage/BasicStatus values. RawNode internals are never assigned.
Finite serial event loop supplies transport and separate local append/application completion; exact network duplication is the only injected event.

Observation correction for issue 8178c42684824a00b28c4cf37110d7d3: bounds-check storage lookup with LastIndex and expose stored_before_ready (positive presence), replacing pending_storage (its inverse). The necessity implication is equivalent: absent storage implies zero direct acknowledgments.
